notes.title: Update 1.0.5 (2)
notes.content:
Quick update ;)

[list]
[*] If a unit is in a panic and on the run, its attack is drastically reduced and the enemy has a better chance of killing the unit's soldiers.
[*] Holding left CTRL and right-clicking on a unit's icon in the Army window will automatically disband it.
[*] The probability of the ruler's wife death is greatly reduced on large maps.
[*] Fixed a bug where recruited units were showing in reverse order and were also getting deleted incorrectly.
[*] Added basic province traits in Defender of the Kingdom map.
[*] Fixed Sherwood province appearing 2x in Defender of the Kingdom map.
[*] Ministers in the council have their loyalty increased much faster. Appointments can be used to increase loyalty faster.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998863/f6d37f25a2a48e1c3083bb5e8ea6a706d389c59e.png"][/img]
Hello friends, the update 1.0.5 is out!
[/p][p]I hope you enjoyed your summer. I was more busy than I wanted to be, but at least I can release a new update. It brings a new compact map. I've combined your two requests into this one map - a very small map with only a few provinces and then a port of the great old strategy Defender of the Crown, one of several games that inspired Bellfortis. Unfortunately I can't do that one, of course, but the new map is at least inspired by this game. Aside from that, I'm bringing a few changes and improvements to it, also based on your feedbacks.[/p][p]
So what's new in 1.0.5?[/p][list][*][p]New Defender of the Kingdom map with only 20 provinces.[/p][/*][*][p]New Outlaws faction for Defender of the Kingdom map.[/p][/*][*][p]Governor's loyalty increases or decreases depending on the level of the province and the current mood in the city.[/p][/*][*][p]Governor Loyalty increases when there are more than 5 military units in a province. If there is none, it may decrease slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]If the province defends itself against an attack, the governor's loyalty will increase if there is a governor.[/p][/*][*][p]If a player attacks another faction without declaring war, the other factions may respond by changing relations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Untrustworthy trait.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Dismounted Knights icon and inclusion (in some factions they were mistakenly listed as an archery unit).[/p][/*][*][p]Battle AI: If an enemy has a larger number of archers or catapults, they are more likely to attack with them first with a ranged attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Clouds reacting to the mouse cursor are back! 🙂[/p][/*][*][p]Level 1 and 2 provinces are less likely to build defenses.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the range of defensive towers by 25%. Oh, you're not going to like this! 🙂[/p][/*][*][p]If you want to trigger a positive political action and your ruler has the Trustworthy trait, your chance to success increases by 5%. But if you have the Untrustworthy trait, your chance decreases by 10%.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the new map Defender of the Kingdom to the Demo version.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support and feedback. And if you like the game, please don't forget to share a review![/p][p]  Pavel, Rake in Grass..[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998863/127e2e13e49cc1d5097c3e3b55228b47209c3e80.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello friends![/p][p][/p][p]The new update 1.0.4 is out! It's a smaller update, it mainly improves gameplay and fixes some bugs, but I wanted to release it because I want to work on bigger changes that will take a longer time (advertised modding support and new DLC). Also, I need to rest now ːsteamboredː, after two and a half years of developing the game I need a vacation, so you won't hear much from me until the end of August.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What's new in 1.0.4?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed two newly reported crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified AI behavior - in the later stages of the game and in war, it behaves more aggressively and even more peaceful factions try to build armies. Need more feedback from you to make it better![/p][/*][*][p]Modified AI behavior - rewritted decision-making on construction.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted chances of some political actions (like peace, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]On higher difficulties, the initial chance of success of an action is lowered (by 10 % on hard and 15 % on very hard).[/p][/*][*][p]If the AI is at war with the player, the AI tries to build an army faster in provinces adjacent to the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to disable killing soldiers with archers of own army to settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some minor issues.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support and feedback! It is important to make the game better. I'll be waiting for new reports to see if the AI aggressiveness you've often written about has increased.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998863/5f1ba7dbc6ee131a9b1dbdce31b28708afb0965f.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello friends![/p][p][/p][p]The new update 1.0.3 is out now and brings more than 20 changes including the first version of the game editor.[/p][p]To start the editor, enable the editor in Options and then use F1 to start the editor in the game (after starting a new scenario). It still needs a lot of work (for example, it crashes if you try to load a map in it that you haven't saved before and therefore doesn't exist), it's not perfect, and most importantly, it will need at least a basic manual, but I'm going to write one with modding support. It is not supported yet and the only way how to run the new map is to open it in the editor. The files are saved in the Documents/Bellfortis directory.[/p][p]Once modding is supported, you'll also be able to change the map image, theoretically add factions and units and such, though it will need more work.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New in the update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a test version of the scenario editor. Missing manual, but it will come with the modfing support probably in the next update.[/p][/*][*][p]Chinese localization[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 3 types of crashes. [b]Thanks to everyone for reporting them![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added button to delete saved game.[/p][/*][*][p]If you have higher than 50% espionage (must have Master Spy action or intrigue bonuses), the chance to intrigue is +10%.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the cost on Master Spy from 50 an 20 prestige.[/p][/*][*][p]Music on the map and in battles is not repeated, it changes randomly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the attacking catapult running out of ammo. If the catapult runs out of ammo now it doesn't attack, it stands still and tries to retreat when enemies are close.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified Europe in War alternative map - added Jerusalem province.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed West Frankish unit Freres Gueries.[/p][/*][*][p]For sieges, the SPACE key can be used to fire a catapult.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bad movement of Dismounted Knights units in all factions.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the "Show location" buttons - pressing them closes the main menu, the camera will pan to the province, after a while the main menu will turn on again.[/p][/*][*][p]In Legends, Taltos were able to control the weather. In the game they can't be hit by lightning.[/p][/*][*][p]In battle, the defending AI can engage even if you're outnumbered.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Alliance action.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed province or kingdom acquisition action when multiple major provinces appeared.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebels show local culture.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased some time limits and adjusted the requirements of nobles in their quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tooltips in the menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced speed Varju Horse Archers[/p][/*][*][p]And a lot of minor fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998863/7428b1add0b3f3c10da8d4b85b3d0b999a6f6bc9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello friends![/p][p][/p][p]The new update 1.0.2 is out now and brings dozens of changes, fixes and improvements![/p][p][/p][p]Based on feedbacks, I've adjusted the game's economy. It's a struggle with it because some people find the difficulty extremely hard, others find it very easy when they know what to do. So I decided to simplify the beginning of the game, especially on Easy and Standard difficulties. I'll need to test it longer and see what you guys say. I'm ready to address this further in the next update. But I believe the game is a bit better again. From the content I added one map of smaller Europe. While it is based on the main large map of Europe, it only shows about half of the provinces. Consider it a bonus :)[/p][p][/p][p]I also keep the old version of the game in the Beta Branch on Steam, if someone wants to play the old version of Bellfortis, but otherwise the old gamesaves are fully playable in the new version, it may just happen that you see a slightly different production or public order after the loading.[/p][p]
[b]New in the update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added an alternative map of Europe with fewer provinces for faster gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Completely redesigned system of mood and Public order.[/p][/*][*][p]If another faction joins you, relations between you and the enemies of that faction will deteriorate. Conversely, relations with their friends will improve.[/p][/*][*][p]If you are joined by another faction that was not on good terms with you, public order will be reduced in those provinces for several rounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to sort provinces by Public Order to the list of provinces.[/p][/*][*][p]In the list of provinces there is now a button for each province to jump to that province.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced likelihood of enemies using defensive towers ;)[/p][/*][*][p]You can skip the castle capture with catapult interlude.[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned the Governor and Nobles selection window.[/p][/*][*][p]When selecting a Governor or a Noble for the Royal Council, Nobles can now be sorted by ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased speed and stamina of some wild Viking units due to the ability to better attack enemy archers (since they have no cavalry).[/p][/*][*][p]Added several mentor messages to alert players about, for example, placing people on the royal council, raising the level of a city, adding a governor, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Factions Wales, Picts and Bulgarians added to the big map of Europe.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the functionality of trade routes - they can now be used only once on an entire alien faction and for each trade route arranged the player gets +4% to income.[/p][/*][*][p]VSync button added to options.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Steppe Archers unit to the Bulgarian faction.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed single battle of Serdica (assigned to Bulgarians instead of Hungarians).[/p][/*][*][p]AI battle system redesigned. It looks the same, it behaves the same, but inside it's different! :) It will be easier to improve in the future.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug when part of the attacking army did not attack and units stood still.[/p][/*][*][p]The catapult can now pass through your other soldiers, they will spread out.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player would get negative bonuses for random actions in foreign countries (like plague).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player playing as Vikings should have received cavalry units as a quest reward from the nobility, but Vikings don't have cavalry units.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified battle sounds - reduced screaming of wounded soldiers and added new sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]The construction of the marketplace now does not need the construction of a town centre.[/p][/*][*][p]Residents' earnings have increased on easy and standard difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Added crash detection system. Very rarely someone reports a crash that we can't replicate unfortunately. I hope it will help.[/p][/*][*][p]And about 40 other minor fixes. :)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for the great support and for the feedback you send me![/p][p]  Pavel "Tovy", Rake in Grass..[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 V3
notes.content: Fixed a memory leak causing the game to crash.

notes.title: Bellfortis - Update 1.0.1
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998863/f5800519ad682fcf554c2b34cda6668b0a0e37cd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello friends![/p][p]Following the release of the game, we are bringing you the first update that tweaks and improves the gameplay in many ways and adds many small but gameplay-interesting improvements that you have written to us about.[/p][p]The most important is the ability to drag an army around one of your own provinces, which will speed up troop movement. Also important is the ability for provinces to upkeep 1-3 units.[/p][p]In addition to the combat system, which has been tweaked (for example, soldiers are pushing each other less, catapults can destroy defense objects etc.), we've added a much slower combat system that will be welcomed by those who want more control over their soldiers in battle.[/p][p]I hope you enjoy it![/p][p][/p][p][b]New in the update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The army can move up to 2 own provinces. However, it can only attack the adjacent land if it has not moved.[/p][/*][*][p]Provinces maintain a garrison that the monarch does not have to pay. The crew is 1 to 3 units, depending on the level of the city.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted trade and prices of food and construction material in the shop slightly reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified some building properties. For example, the income from the City Center has been increased from 100 to 150 gold.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted (mostly increased) prices of some inventions.[/p][/*][*][p]Most political actions depend on prestige only.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified random events, their prizes and rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Anglo-Saxon and Celtic cultures have an approach to brewery construction.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased font readability and added experimental font enlargement to Options.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where in combat when holding and dragging the right mouse, archers would start shooting at their friendly units.[/p][/*][*][p]Fine-tuned collisions and collision behaviour of units on the battlefield.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Tactical Battles II battle mode to slow down battles even more. Experimental ;)[/p][/*][*][p]Catapult can destroy defense objects now too. And ignite them.[/p][/*][*][p]When a battle is triggered, you can now even pick up defensive elements from the battlefield.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a large amount of enemy units were accumulated in an enemy province.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0 RC
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998863/7a5386bede7e0b1a1715b6da0a97a0cd8328f02b.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear friends![/p][p][/p][p]The official release of Bellfortis is a week away, but for those of you who supported us in Early Access, we're already bringing you version 1.0. We would like to thank you all. Your support during EA has helped us create this new content. notes.title: Update 0.92
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998863/03e797bb6a1df338cbbe9a632970e85cff0703ad.png[/img]

Hello friends!

We're preparing new content for the final version of the game, which needs a lot of testing, but we've taken the time to do a smaller update that brings a few changes to the GUI design, gameplay and most importantly the AI behaviour on the map.

News in the patch:
[list]
[*] Added a battle progress bar at the top of the screen and slightly changed gui design.
[*] Archer range increased by 25%.
[*] Improved AI city defence system.
[*] The new AI also uses turrets for defence.
[*] AI can raise the level of provinces.
[*] AI can buy upgrades.
[*] Added their own cultures to the West Franks (Frankish), Asturias (Asturian) and the Byzantine Empire (Byzantine).
[*] Lots of minor tweaks and fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.8.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998863/3c10a26ebd8d1de2584541801d26cf04f93781a7.png[/img]

Our friends!

We've got another update for you under the number 0.8.5. Besides Steam achievement support, it mainly brings improvements suggested by the community - for example, the ability to merge incomplete units
or faction-dependent images of generals. Ejoy the changes! And while you can try it out, we're already working on new improvements ;)

[b]New in 0.8.5:[/b]

- Added Steam achievements!
- In the campaign selection, the game offers the possibility to randomly generate the strength of factions (which provinces it owns) and even randomly place factions on the map.
- Added basic gamepad support.
- The most of factions have own portrait of the generals.
- Now you can have more VIPs on your Governor list. You can scroll with the list.
- If there is no military garrison in the invaded country, a quick battle is always triggered.
- Corrected result of a battle when there is no garrison in the invaded province.
- You can only try to take over a kingdom by asking for the hand of the monarch's daughter once per round (and sure you cannot have another wife! :)
- Joining units - if you select one unit in a province and then right click on another unit of a similar type (e.g. infantry to infantry, cavalry to cavalry, etc.), you can transfer soldiers from that unit to the unit already selected.
-  Modified actions Alliance, Land purchase and Land acquisition.

[b]Thank you for any feedback! If you'd like to stay in touch with us more, you can find us on Discord, for example, or just drop us a line here on the Steam forums.[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.8.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998863/89d73fd809978b1ca91202ff9d9fee3f3be83e9a.jpg[/img]

Hi!

The new update is here and with it a bunch of major and minor improvements. The major news is a new map of the attractive struggle between the Christian and Muslim empires for control of the Iberian Peninsula. A gameplay-interesting change is the addition of a system of generals - prominent commanders who bring bonuses to units in battles.

We hope you like our improvements. [b]Don't forget to give us feedback.[/b] The development of the game is nearing completion and we hope to have the game out of Early Access soon (still weeks or months). But don't worry, we plan to keep working on the game even after the full game is released. There are plenty of plans! :)

[b]News in 0.8.4:[/b]
[list]
[*] New large map of Reconquista - the struggle between Christians and Muslims for control of the Iberian Peninsula.
[*] Added generals. During the course of the game, a Unit Commander can promote to General. This unit then receives bonuses to defense and attack, and sometimes other bonuses applied to other units on the field.
[*] After the battle there is a chance that one of the unit commanders will become a general. In battles with superior numbers, the odds are higher.
[*] Added one new background and tree tileset into battles.
[*] Constantinople now has city walls at the start of the game!
[*] The enemy faction no longer offers to buy your province.
[*] Fixed a bug where the AI increases the number of units in an army beyond the limit (for saved positions, units are kept but no longer increased).
[*] Adjusted country efficiency (when a country is small, efficiency is higher, with size it gradually decreases due to bureaucracy and empire size).
[*] Added short chapters on kingdom effectiveness and generals to the handbook.
[*] The small plus icons under the army and building buttons indicate that there is a vacant building position in the city.
[*] Market now produce +5 food per turn.
[*] Single battles are always fought in tactical mode.
[*] Dozens of minor tweaks such as adjusting the game's economy, AI, etc.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.82
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998863/2836bc33869aa60c311b839d9309dcfa53a59ef1.jpg[/img]

Hi! A minor update, but one that brought some interesting fixes mostly thanks to player feedbacks!

[b]What's new?[/b]

[list]
[*] German localization added!
[*] You can now return from faction selection to campaign selection when you start the game.
[*] In Options, you can turn off computer move tracking.
[*] Now you can open the ingame menu while moving the computer by pressing the Escape key.
[*] Rebellious provinces can secede from kingdoms - both the enemy's and yours.
[*] Very slow speed button added to battle.
[*] Invention Co-participation added to research - the province pays 10% of the cost of the military, but the public order is reduced by 10%.
[*] Slightly adjusted (mostly increased) resources at game start.
[*] Battle challenges now have one constant weather for each map.
[*] Slightly modified AI behaviour in the later part of the game (e.g. more chances to attack).
[*] A few minor changes and improvements.
[/list]

And we'rlready working on more improvements and new content!

notes.title: Update 0.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998863/c1a94b54fb3983b249e109063de07d377d34a367.jpg[/img]

Hello conquerors!

The new and really big update 0.8 brings a large map of Europe and the Mediterranean area including North Africa! Now you can choose from a total of 15 factions and build a magnificent empire, stretching from Egypt to Scotland.

What's new?

[list]
[*] Added a large map of Europe including the Mediterranean with North Africa and the Middle East.
[*] Added 5 new factions to the Europe map: Byzantine Empire, Bohemia, Asturia, Abbasid Caliphate and Emirate of Cordoba.
[*] Added three new single battles that can be played for time and score.
[*] The player can turn off the weather in battles in Options for a better overview.
[*] Map AI: The enemy may form an alliance with another faction against you.
[*] Map AI: Some factions, seeing that they can be defeated, will join another larger faction.
[*] Reduced chance of soldiers fleeing from the battle (they fled too much :)
[*] A few minor changes and improvements.
[/list]

We apologize that some localizations do not contain translated new texts, the content is being added faster than we can update it. We will add localizations continuously.

[b]And since this is a really big update and we'll continue to improve it, we'd be grateful for any feedback![/b] Thanks and enjoy the update! :)

notes.title: Patch 0.7.5 (2)
notes.content:
- When starting a new map, the player can choose the difficulty of the game.
- Added the function to show a province, for example when you receive an offer from an opponent to sell a province.
- And a few other minor fixes.

notes.title: Update 0.7.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998863/e30e8678eebc5fa62120407f6dedf7612d8533eb.png[/img]

We bring you update 0.7.5 with several interesting gameplay improvements. Thanks to all the game fans who write us comments for the great feedback!

[b]While you can enjoy the update, we're already working on a new one - next time we'll finally get a new map (among other things)![/b]

What has changed?

[list]
[*] The computer now actively tries to use political actions, whether positive (e.g. offer an alliance), neutral (try to buy land from you), or negative (sabotage, kill the governor, bribe the governor, etc.).
[*] Added Royal Council where you can assemble a council of nobles and scholars and use their skills.
[*] The Royal Council can focus on one of several tasks you choose. For example, it can actively set optimal taxes in the provinces to make the most money for you, but without the people revolting.
[*] The people on your council may die of age or disease in much the same way as governors, for example.
[*] You can now turn on Tactical Battles in the game Options. These fights are a bit slower (soldiers are slower to kill), so they are for those who want to be more tactical.
[*] Fixed a bug with important people "Inventors", some of them had no bonuses.
[*] Modified font system to support Asian languages.
[*] After conquering a territory, the mood is very bad for a while, it remains, but in certain cases you can partially influence it with military garrison and low taxes.
[*] Fixed quest "Don't attack".
[*] If you conquer a territory that has been plundered before or the people there are rebelling, it can in turn lift the spirits of the inhabitants. They see you as a liberator.
[*] If the nobility wants to declare war on someone, they'll pick them from the factions you have the worst relations with.
[*] The marketplace revenue bonus is reduced from 50 to 20 percent.
[*] And lots of other smaller fixes.
[/list]

Enjoy it and look forward to more improvements!

notes.title: Update 0.7.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998863/7effd98623a936aceb55f20b55d95015aaa7a2a1.jpg[/img]

Hi! We have the first interesting update (0.7.4) for you, with a lot of changes. I'm sure you will like it, because we took inspiration from your feedback from the first Early Access version!

What has changed?

[list]
[*] An overview window of all provinces in your kingdom where you can individually set taxes, governor etc.
[*] Change army creations by AI. AI is trying to attack with larger armies than before.
[*] Battles: if you attack the AI first, it doesn't wait as long before attacking back.
[*] Battles: warrior heads reduced by 15%, a compromise between cartoon and realistic heads. Smaller heads are more realistic, but again units are harder to recognize on the battlefield.
[*] Battles: if a unit is fleeing from a battle, a broken morale icon appears above it.
[*] Economics: Reduced production of technology.
[*] Economics: Price of inventions adjusted, usually slightly increased.
[*] Slightly reduced population in the provinces.
[*] The added diplomat icon (which means you have a diplomat in the province) appears above the province flag, similar to a spy.
[*] Fixed the stats for completed battles when a player is attacked by an enemy (they were backwards).
[*] The "Blackmail" action can no longer be run on Rebels and costs more prestige.
[*] When buying buildings, a tooltip with important information about the buildings appears above the buttons.
[*] French localization updated.
[*] Adjusted calculation for Quick Battle.
[*] The efficiency of a large kingdom decreases much faster.
[*] The AI recruits units faster as time goes on if it has few units in a province.
[*] After the conquest of a territory, it is not possible to recruit units in it for a while. If the province is of another culture or the land is plundered, the time is longer.
[/list]

Enjoy it and look forward to more improvements!
